howItWorks.title: How Episto works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to send a professional letter.
howItWorks.step1Detail: Tell us what kind of letter you need. We guide the structure and prepare a formal letter in the correct Swiss format.
howItWorks.step2Detail: Review every section of your letter. Edit the sender, recipient, body, and attachments. Add your signature if needed.
howItWorks.step3Detail: Choose standard or registered delivery. Pay securely with card or TWINT. We prepare the final PDF for postal submission. Printing and handover to Swiss Post delivery services require at least one day at the earliest.
howItWorks.faq1a: At least one day is required, at the earliest, before the PDF is printed and handed over to Swiss Post delivery services. After handover, delivery time depends on Swiss Post and the delivery type you choose.
howItWorks.faq2a: Registered letters usually include Swiss Post tracking. Standard letters do not. If tracking is available, we show the tracking number after acceptance for dispatch and you then follow the shipment through Swiss Post.
howItWorks.faq3a: No. You can draft and send a letter as a guest. If you leave before checkout, we give you a secure link to resume your draft.
howItWorks.faq4q: When is my payment actually charged?
howItWorks.faq4a: Only after the postal provider accepts your letter for dispatch. If the letter is rejected before that, you are not charged.

pricing.faq1a: Only after the postal provider accepts the letter for dispatch. If the submission is rejected before that, you are not charged.
pricing.faq2a: Yes, if the problem was caused by our service before or during dispatch submission. Once Swiss Post has accepted the letter, there is no refund for a change of mind or for postal issues after handoff. Any approved refund is returned to the original payment method.
pricing.faq3a: The price covers one letter: drafting support, final PDF creation, provider-side printing and postal dispatch costs included in that order, dispatch submission handling, and payment processing. Pricing is per letter, and each order is charged separately.
pricing.faq4q: Is VAT included in the prices shown?

help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Answers and contact
help.faq1q: How do I write a letter?
help.faq1a: Click 'Write a letter', describe your situation, and review the draft section by section before checkout. You can edit the text until the letter is submitted for dispatch.
help.faq2q: When is my letter actually sent?
help.faq2a: After checkout, we prepare the final PDF and submit the order into the provider flow. Printing and handover to Swiss Post delivery services require at least one day at the earliest. Acceptance means handoff to Swiss Post, not delivery to the recipient.
help.faq3a: Only if Swiss Post provides tracking for that shipment, which is typically the case for registered letters. If tracking is available, we show it after acceptance for dispatch and you then rely on Swiss Post tracking.
help.faq4q: Who is responsible after Swiss Post accepts my letter?
help.faq4a: After Swiss Post has taken over, Swiss Post handles printing, transport, tracking, and delivery. If tracking is available, you should rely on Swiss Post tracking. We do not control delays or delivery issues after handover.
help.faq5q: What if my payment fails or looks wrong?
help.faq5a: If payment fails, you can retry checkout without rewriting your letter. We only capture payment after acceptance for dispatch. If you think you were charged incorrectly, contact support and we will review it.
help.faq6q: Can I edit my letter after paying?
help.faq6a: No. Once checkout is completed and the letter is submitted for dispatch, the content is locked and cannot be changed.
help.faq7a: You can attach PDF, PNG, and JPEG files. The current limit is 5 MB per file, up to 5 attachments in total.
help.faq8a: No. You can draft and send a letter as a guest. We give you a secure resume link if you leave before checkout.
help.contactDescription: If your question isn't answered above, reach out to us.
help.contactResponseTime: We aim to respond within one business day.
